fields.label: HMIS Provisioning Status API
fields.description: Optional read-only route published through the HIE API gateway. It reuses the HIE JWT credentials above.

fields.label: External HMIS Setup Service
fields.description: When URL, API key, and API secret are all configured, facility status uses the external setup API. Otherwise it uses the HIE gateway configuration above. Use a dedicated Frappe service user API key and secret; do not use an Administrator password.
Shown to facility users as the usual wait while their HMIS site is set up, when the setup service does not report an estimate. Set 0 to hide.
fields.label: Typical HMIS Setup Time (minutes)

fields.description: When on, CRM asks the setup service to create the facility's setup record without deploying it, and the implementation team starts deployment in the setup service. When off, deployment starts automatically.
fields.label: Review HMIS Deployments Before They Start

fields.description: Turn this on only after the OpenMeter Mediator app, the metering gateway and the HMIS balance pull are deployed. Until then HMIS keeps receiving its tokens in the provisioning payload.
fields.label: HMIS Token Metering

fields.description: New provisioning requests send token_source openmeter, tokens_awarded 0, a metering site key and the token purchase link. HMIS then reads its balance from OpenMeter, where CRM grants the tokens.
fields.label: Use OpenMeter as the HMIS Token Source

fields.description: Where HMIS sends users whose tokens have run out. Leave empty to use this site's CX portal.
fields.label: Token Purchase URL
